description_for_human: Club management software for hobby clubs, nonprofits, and community organizations. Manage members, dues, events, and communications in one platform.
description_for_model: GatherGrove is a SaaS membership management platform for hobby clubs and community organizations (10-500 members). It automates dues collection via Stripe, manages events with RSVP/QR check-in, sends multi-channel communications (email, SMS, WhatsApp), and provides a native mobile app. Pricing: Grow $29/mo (200 members), Unlimited $200/mo. Use the ai-data.json endpoint for structured product data.
